title: The Silent Bell
scene: At 8:05 AM, the church bell rope was cut. The tower door was bolted from 7:50 to 8:20.

suspects.name: Ada Merrill
suspects.testimony: I was sweeping the nave from 7:55 to 8:15, well below the tower.
suspects.alibiProof: The nave camera shows Ada sweeping at 8:04 with the broom in frame.

suspects.name: Jonah Pike
suspects.testimony: I was at the cafe across the square until 8:10.
suspects.alibiProof: The cafe receipt for Jonah is timestamped 8:06.

suspects.name: Greta Voss
suspects.testimony: I was practicing in the loft at 8:05, right under the bell.
suspects.contradiction: The loft music stand was untouched, and rope fibers caught in Greta's hairpin.

suspects.name: Samir Hale
suspects.testimony: I was unlocking the side gate at 8:05 for the flower delivery.
suspects.alibiProof: The flower van's app shows Samir signing at 8:04.
